notes.title: Eva Reynes Release and Future of Eredia
notes.notes:
Heya Eredians!

It's been a while.
Dropping by to say that I've finished developing Eva Reynes; please check out the store page using the link below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1055150/Eva_Reynes/

This also means that I'll get to work on Eredia 2 in about a week or so. More news on that soon!
If you support us by buying Eredia and Eva Reynes, it'll go a long way in ensuring I can afford to deliver the quality I strive to achieve.

Cheers,

notes.title: NEW CONTENT Update Version 1.1 and Anniversary Sale (70% Discount)!
notes.notes:
Hellow Fellow Potatoes!

It's almost a year since I released Eredia: Diary of Heroes (boy, time flies quickly, huh?), and we've been on quite the ride so far. Bug fixes, improvements, edits, we've done it all to make Eredia a better game, and we did it together.

I've heard the demands for the sequel, and I'm pleasantly surprised by the response. Now, I won't be able to get Eredia 2 out in 2019, but I got a little anniversary gift for you all.

This is the first update that brings to you new content. (Mostly end game stuff)

- 3 new legendary weapons.
- One rare and one legendary armor set (total 5).
- Two new runestones.
- One new EX-Boss. (Okay, tbh, this fight is a little unfair, but if Gara and Shirven didn't pose too much of a challenge for you, you're probably gonna have fun with this one.)
- One Follow-up mission added in the Hunter's Guild. (Must have finished escorting the thief from Navrok Port. This isn't an official contract, and it doesn't get added to the Journal.)
- Minor bug fixes, including the recently reported Game Over bug after the Kredvale trials.

NOTE: 90% of the new content can only be accessed after getting a ship. Try revisiting some of the islands again.

And that's not all. For this week only, Eredia is on SALE (70% OFF)! 

Also, if you haven't done so already, collect your FREE Eredia Lorebook from our official website by subscribing to our mailing list.

https://www.potatobraingames.com/

Finally, I'd like to request two things from our new players:

- Please leave a review if you play the game, and give me your honest feedback, regardless of whether it's a pat on the back or a brutal spinning heel kick. Feedback helps a lot, seriously.

- If you like detective/mystery games, you can give my new WIP game a try. 
I'd love to hear your opinions.

https://www.potatobraingames.com/eva-reynes

Cheers,
Rishi

notes.title: Minor Patch (Version 1.0.5) and BIG news!
notes.notes:
First of all, I'd like to start by wishing you all a Happy New Year!

2018 has been a hell of a journey for me, and I'm going to continue doing what I love doing in 2019 as well: making games!

But more importantly, I've come up with three gifts for all players who've supported me on this journey, and new players who are looking to join the bandwagon.

The first one is an exclusive digital Eredia Lore Book which will be sent to all our mailing list subscribers by the end of January. 
It'll contain all the information you wanted to know about the world of Arlis, it's history, the empires, the gods, and just about everything else. 

The second gift will be for two lucky random subscribers every month, who'll get a FREE Steam key for any of our games! 

And if that's not all, ALL SUBSCRIBERS will have access to pre-order Eva Reynes with a 30% discount! 

How to Subscribe: 

- Open my website: www.potatobraingames.com 
- Wait for a subscription popup. 
- Enter your email address and submit. 

That's all! Far simpler than baking a cake, and probably more rewarding, too.

For those who don't know about Eva Reynes, it's the newest game that I'm working on. I plan to finish developing within the first half of 2019, after which I'll immediately start working on Eredia 2. I'll also be starting a Kickstarter campaign around the mid of February, and I'd really really appreciate it if you could support the game. More details about the game can be found on my website.

https://www.potatobraingames.com/eva-reynes 

Oh, and before I forget, I better write the patch notes as well:

- Fixed the bug where the Black Ram didn't appear in the player's house after adopting it.

- Fixed Mount Aedelen passage issues and inconsistencies.

- Fixed lore inconsistencies, e.g. Rurouna's hometown being marked as Glendeva instead of Floreigne.

- Fixed passage issues in Draedenvir. 

- Fixed typos and improved text formatting.

If you read till the end, you're awesome!

Cheers,
Rishi

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.2 (Bug Fixes and Improvements)
notes.notes:
Hello Eredians!

I know it's been a bit overdue, but here's the second patch.

Note: If auto-update fails, please uninstall and reinstall Eredia in Steam; your save files should be intact. You can backup your save files, too, just to be on the safe side.

Fixed Hidden Lamia Village passage bug.
Fixed the passage bug in the Tower of Giants.
Fixed the issue where some Shenrigan trees could not be interacted with.
Fixed several textual inconsistencies.
Fixed the issue of certain armor being categorized incorrectly.
Runestones can now be purchased from the Supreme Elf in Caliendeah Beach.
Premium lotto option has been removed.
Fixed the bug which allowed you to participate in tournaments with locked characters.
Removed 'Angelic' skill from Rurouna's auto-learning skills and made it exclusively obtainable from the Mage Guild.
Fixed the Alchemist Quest bug in Underlord's castle.
Fixed some transfer event bugs.
Fixed several issues in the Corsine basement.
Fixed the issue of the Black Ram not appearing after adopting it.
Fixed the bug which allowed the player to fight Asanthi multiple times.
Fixed some passability issues which prevented the player from reaching certain treasure chests.
Fixed the alchemy quiz bug.
Fixed the issue where Slayer's Badge appeared twice instead of Veteran's Badge.
Fixed the drinking contest bug.
Fixed the Efreex reward bug.
Added a minor default TP gain for simple Attack and Guard.
Fixed the Kredvale Academy and Hunter's Guild description errors.
Fixed skill descriptions and incorrect icons.
Fixed the issue where Fox Goddess armor sets did not appear in the crafting menu.
Fixed some typos and minor bugs.

I really appreciate the bug reports and feedback that I got from the community thus far. Without your support, I would not have been able to improve Eredia to this point. I'll continue improving the game over the months to come, and the next target is a Mac release.

Keep those reviews coming!

Cheers,
Rishi

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.1 (Several Bug Fixes and Improvements)
notes.notes:
Hello Eredians!

It has been a little over a week since the release, and I love the response that I got thus far!

In this patch, I have fixed most of the bugs that were reported since Eredia was released.
I truly appreciate the bug reports and improvement suggestions that I got in the past eleven days.

Note: If auto-update fails, please uninstall and reinstall Eredia in Steam; your save files should be intact.

Fixed the clock UI.
Fixed Mountaineer and Miner achievements. To activate missing achievements, just enter Kenrad's home in Midglen.
Fixed several passability and tiling issues.
Fixed the Kredvale Academy bugs.
Fixed certain items not appearing in the menu, e.g. Gold Nuggets.
Fixed several dialogue inconsistencies and typos.
Crossbows can now be equipped.
Fixed scrolls not casting the appropriate skills.
Fixed the issue of wrong BGMs playing in certain maps.
Fixed several mapping inconsistencies.
Fixed the bug where Arshen appeared at the inn even after the cutscene.
Fixed the issue of orcs attacking you in Westerlos even if you don't take up the contract.
Fixed Tower of Giants and Drachnir quest bugs.
Fixed the casino crashes.
Mutliple other bug fixes and improvements.

Some minor bugs are yet to be fixed, but I am researching on ways to crush them soon.

Finally, I'd really appreciate it if you could spend a few minutes of your time and write a short review for Eredia in the reviews section. Feedback is what keeps devs going, and it will help me mold Eredia into a better game.

Cheers,
Rishi

notes.title: Eredia Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Good morning, good afternoon, good evening, ladies and gentlemen!

The kraken has been released!...Okay, I'll stop with the bad jokes, now.
My first commercial game, Eredia: The Diary of Heroes, has finally been released!

For those who are not familiar with our title, Eredia is a dark fantasy JRPG game set in a vast open world with over 50 hours of non-linear gameplay. It follows the life of Kenrad Krauser, a hunter trying to make the most of his opportunities in a war-ravaged world.

Eredia is available for purchase in Steam and itch.io.

Note: For now, only the Windows version is available. Mac and Linux versions will be available in approximately one month.

To all those who have supported me and have been a part of this wonderful journey: thank you.
